units.source_text: 反倒是来年立春之前，一向自以为身强体健的阿民得了伤寒，发病第八天就呜呼哀哉，死掉了。

en.t: Instead, before the Beginning of Spring the following year, Amin, who had always considered himself strong and healthy, came down with typhoid; on the eighth day after falling ill, he breathed his last and died.

units.source_text: 实际上，那时候村里已经有不知道多少人患上了风寒。

en.t: In fact, by that time, who knew how many people in the village had already come down with the cold.

units.source_text: 而且，阿民在发病之前，曾经帮忙为因伤寒去世的铁匠的葬礼，挖掘墓穴。

en.t: Moreover, before Amin fell ill, he had helped dig the grave for the funeral of the blacksmith who had died of typhoid.

units.source_text: 铁匠有个小徒弟当时也染上了风寒，葬礼当天才被送到医院。

en.t: The blacksmith had a young apprentice who had also caught the cold at the time, and he was only sent to the hospital on the day of the funeral.

units.source_text: “应该就是那个时候被传染上风寒的。”

en.t: "He must have caught the cold then."

units.source_text: ——阿住在医生走了之后，对因为高烧而满脸通红的阿民稍加训斥。

en.t: After the doctor left, Azhu mildly scolded Amin, whose face was flushed red from the high fever.
